title: Add RAG agent quickstarts and tool-calling examples; docs site updates
author: Aisha Patel
description: Adds a new set of RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) agent quickstarts and tool-calling examples aimed at helping developers onboard faster. This PR includes: 1) new RAG templates (prompt + retrieval wiring) under docs/rag and examples/rag-templates, 2) two opinionated agent examples that demonstrate tool-calling for knowledge retrieval and structured tool outputs under examples/agents, 3) docs site updates with interactive quickstart snippets and a troubleshooting section for common mismatch issues, 4) small SDK example adjustments to the TS/py quickstarts to show the new tool-calling helpers. Motivation: engineers repeatedly ask for end-to-end examples showing RAG + agent tool-calling flows (ENG-4821). The changes prioritize low-friction copy-paste examples, clear security notes for private deployments, and concise troubleshooting tips for vector store schema mismatches. Checklist: [x] Add templates and examples [x] Update docs site quickstarts [x] Add minimal tests for agent examples [x] Run docs build and link check [x] Add release notes. Testing performed: local docs site build, link checker run, example smoke tests in CI (containerized). No runtime changes to serving runtime; purely docs/examples. See linked commits for granular changes.
